verdict.rationale: An API is a fair question for a government business-records portal, so this axis applies. The evidence describes only the bizfile web portal plus mail and in-person submission, and no documented API exists for filing, searching, or ordering. Probes of OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. Bulk data files are a separate download feature, not API parity with the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
